high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "naghma.rizwan," who posted it 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post includes a photo of a person sitting at a table, eating instant noodles from a cup. The individual is wearing a sleeveless shirt and is focused on the noodles. The background shows a tiled wall with various posters and artwork, including what looks like a movie poster for "Logan" (a film featuring Wolverine). There is also a small potted plant with red flowers on the table, adding a touch of color to the otherwise muted tones of the room
